American's Game - Wheel of Fortune® comes to the PlayStation®4 computer entertainment system with HD graphics for the first time!
-Enjoy thousands of unique puzzles which stay true to the original TV Show. 
-Compete with your friends and family online and try to reach the top of the leaderboards.
-Progress through the game by unlocking all the rewards, leveling up and collecting all the souvenirs.
Wheel of Fortune offers both the original TV show‘s DNA as well as unique and new features for both veteran players and new players alike.

titles.trophyTitleDetail: Call of Duty: Black Ops 3 deploys its players into a future where bio-technology has enabled a new breed of Black Ops soldier. Players are now always on and always connected to the intelligence grid and their fellow operatives during battle. In a world more divided than ever, this elite squad consists of men and women who have enhanced their combat capabilities to fight faster, stronger, and smarter. Every soldier has to make difficult decisions and visit dark places in this engaging, gritty narrative.
